jobs.description:
Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? We are recruiting a Production Operator/Production Worker for a leading company specializing in the packaging of nuts. You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

Whether you're just starting your career or already have experience in manufacturing, we offer comprehensive training, ongoing support, and opportunities for career growth. As a Production Operator, you will work in a modern packaging facility equipped with advanced machinery, ensuring production runs smoothly and products meet our quality expectations.

Your Responsibilities

• Set up, operate, and adjust automated packaging and packing machines.

• Monitor product quality and ensure all packaged products meet company standards.

• Troubleshoot minor technical issues and perform basic maintenance tasks.

• Contribute to efficient production planning and continuous process improvement.

• Work closely with fellow operators and team leaders to achieve production targets.

• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workplace in accordance with hygiene and safety regulations.

• You have initial experience working in a production or manufacturing environment, preferably within the fruit and vegetable industry.

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English.

• You have an affinity for technology and production processes.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts when required.

How you'll make an impact:
• Translate technical and functional requirements into refined, manufacturable product designs
• Design housings, layouts, and interfaces that balance form, function, and thermal/mechanical constraints
• Demonstrate excellent 3D modeling skills to create detailed and accurate CAD models for prototypes and production
• Create detailed, realistic renderings of concepts and products using Blender or similar software, as well as leveraging visual AI tools, to support marketing, presentations and internal reviews
• Create clear visuals to communicate concepts effectively, using sketches and renderings for internal reviews, marketing, and presentations
• Work with technical requirements, including thermal management, IP protection, and mechanical performance, applying your problem-solving skills to find practical design solutions
• Maintain 3D CAD models, 2D drawings, compliant with GD&T standards for clear communication with manufacturing partners, and documentation for prototyping and manufacturing
• Coordinate with suppliers to ensure design feasibility, manufacturing quality, and cost-effectiveness
• Support validation and testing of prototypes, gathering feedback to improve future iterations
• Contribute to a consistent product design language that reflects our brand and modular design philosophy What makes you a great fit:
• A Master's degree in Product Design, Industrial Design, or a related field
• 2+ years of relevant experience in product or industrial hardware design
• A strong technical interest and willingness to learn about mechanical design principles
• Excellent 3D modeling skills and experience with CAD software (e.g., Fusion 360, Onshape, SolidWorks). Experience in creating precise 2D technical drawings following GD&T guidelines to ensure clear communication with suppliers
• Proficient rendering skills using Blender, similar software and proficiency in AI-assisted visual tools
• Good knowledge and hands-on experience with 3D printing for prototyping and familiarity with other manufacturing technologies such as CNC machining, die casting, and sheet metal fabrication
• Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud programs (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator) for visuals, presentations, and product material preparation
• A passion for turning technical complexity into clean, practical design solutions
• A collaborative attitude - you enjoy working with engineers, suppliers, and external partners
• Hands-on experience with prototyping and iteration
• Excellent English communication skills are essential as you will be working in an international team and collaborating with clients worldwide
• Ability to commute to Brussels on a daily basis On top of a competitive salary, we offer:
• 32 vacation days (including 12 additional leave days)
• Healthcare benefits (through Alan)
• Group Insurance
• Meal vouchers 
• Flex Income Plan (through Payflip) 
• Stock options 
• The best tools and technology to help you excel in your role
• Fun team drinks & events
• A fancy office in Brussels

How you'll make an impact:
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable internal and customer-facing web platforms and APIs
• Work across the full stack (frontend, backend, database, testing, deployment)
• Design backend services for physical device management, telemetry, software versions, deployments, licensing and subscriptions
• Build integrations with external services such as e-commerce, billing, accounting and other business systems
• Collaborate with hardware and embedded software teams to ensure seamless integration between the hardware and software layers
• Continuously learn and apply new technologies to improve the team's development processes and product offerings What makes you a great fit:
• 3+ years of experience as a Software Developer
• AI-first mindset, with a strong willingness to actively use AI tools in daily software development to improve speed, quality, testing, debugging, and problem-solving
• Strong product mindset, creativity, and the ability to turn ambiguous ideas into well-designed solutions without relying on detailed requirements or predefined designs
• Strong functional analytics and product owner skills
• Current tech stack that you will need to be proficient with: Nuxt, Vue, Python, Django, Postgres
• Familiarity with Linux and Docker containers
• Self-driven, proactive, and able to work autonomously, with a passion for innovation and problem-solving
• Ownership and responsibility will be critical
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
• Location in Europe, with the ability to occasionally be present in the Brussels officeNice to have:
• Familiarity with device management & telemetry
• Experience with a physical hardware and IoT systems is a strong plus
• Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana or Loki is a strong plus
• Hands-on experience with automated testing, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests On top of a competitive salary, we offer:
• 32 vacation days, including 12 additional leave days
• Healthcare benefits (incl Alan daily care)
• Group insurance
• Meal vouchers
• Flex Income Plan (through Payflip)
• Stock options
• Fun team drinks & events
• A brand new office in the heart of Brussels

Kick-start your career in marketing operations, client services and project coordination!

Are you a recent graduate or have had a positive first work experience in a marketing services environment and looking for a role where you can learn fast, take ownership, work with clients in an international environment, and make a real impact from day one?

Our client is looking for an enthusiastic and driven Program Coordinator to join their Belgian team in Hasselt.

This hybrid role combines client communication, project coordination and related admin (quotations, invoicing), vendor communications, operational coordination and process improvement within a dynamic B2B direct marketing environment focused on print, fulfillment and logistics services.

You'll work closely with experienced colleagues who will support, coach and train you while giving you the opportunity to grow into a trusted client and operations professional. We are looking for someone with common sense, energy, curiosity, and a proactive mindset. Someone

who communicates openly and clearly, takes ownership, and challenges the status quo when a better solution exists. 

A forward thinker who anticipates obstacles, identifies opportunities, and consistently stays one step ahead. Comfortable working independently, making sound decisions, and driving initiatives forward with limited supervision, while also recognizing the value of collaboration and actively contributing to a strong team environment. Someone who thrives on solving problems, improving processes, and turning challenges into opportunities for growth and success.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, build strong relationships with colleagues and clients, and bring a practical, can-do approach to business challenges. While previous experience in a similar role is an advantage, we place greater value on attitude, drive, pro-activeness, learning agility, and the potential to make a meaningful impact from day one. No two days are the same. One day you might be coordinating a client project, the next day you could be visiting our warehouse partners, analysing operational performance, or identifying opportunities to improve processes and customer experience.

During your first years with our client, you'll gain experience in: 

 
• Client relationship management 
 
• Project coordination 
 
• Marketing operations 
 
• Print and fulfillment services 
 
• Vendor and warehouse coordination 
 
• Business process improvement 
 
• Data analysis and reporting 
 
• Operational excellence 
 
• Cross-functional collaboration

Our client is a global marketing services organization specializing in multi-channel B2B & B2C marketing solutions that connect their clients with their customers in powerful ways. Experts in defining, executing, and optimizing the customer journey, they offer end-to-end marketing services including consulting, strategic assessment, data, analytics, digital, social, mobile, print, fulfillment, logistics and contact center
solutions. 

 

What You Bring: 

 
• Recent Professional Bachelor or Master's graduate 
 
• Looking for a first professional role with growth opportunities 
 
• Native in Dutch, fluent in French and English (verbal and in writing) 
 
• Naturally proactive, eager to take ownership, and driven to deliver results without waiting to be
asked 
 
• Strong pro-active communicator who enjoys working with both colleagues and clients 
 
• Analytical mindset with an eye for detail 
 
• Curious and solution-oriented 
 
• Comfortable challenging existing processes and proposing improvements 
 
• Able to combine structured thinking with practical execution 
 
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 
• Not afraid to roll up your sleeves when needed and take the extra mile to make it happen 
 
• Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 applications

Our client is a global marketing services organization specializing in multi-channel B2B & B2C marketing solutions that connect their clients with their customers in powerful ways. Experts in defining, executing, and optimizing the customer journey, they offer end-to-end marketing services including consulting, strategic assessment, data, analytics, digital, social, mobile, print, fulfillment, logistics and contact center

solutions. 

Key Responsibilities:

Program & Client Coordination 

 
• Act as the day-to-day operational lead for assigned client programs 
 
• Coordinate all client touchpoints (emails, tickets, calls) in a timely and professional manner 
 
• Facilitate collaboration across internal departments and third-party vendors 
 
• Support the account management teams with their daily client management activities where needed 
 
• Coordinate ongoing program deliverables, reports, meeting notes, and documentation of/updating of project procedures 
 
• Participate in weekly client calls and quarterly business reviews

Project Implementation 
 
• Take ownership of project implementations from initial planning and client alignment through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization 
 
• Maintain clear and structured implementation documentation, process flows, and operational procedures 
 
• Continuously evaluate implemented processes and identify opportunities for further optimization, efficiency improvements, and enhanced client experience 
 
• Ensure operational readiness and successful handover into daily business operations after project completion

Client Relationship & Quality Coordination 
 
• Help developing trusted relationships with client services teams and key client stakeholders 
 
• Monitor program health and ensure SLAs, KPIs, and quality standards are consistently met 
 
• Drive process improvements and identify opportunities for optimization 
 
• Handle escalations from issue identification to resolution 
 
• Assist in preparing client audits and quarterly business reviews

Reporting & Financial Coordination 
 
• Prepare internal and external reports (daily, weekly, monthly metrics) 
 
• Support monthly invoicing activities with accuracy and timeliness 

What You Bring: 

 
• Initial successful experience in a similar coordination, operations, or client service role—experience in pharmaceutical, fulfillment, or digital industries is a strong plus 
 
• Strong client-first mindset, focused on understanding client needs and delivering measurable value 
 
• Out-of-the-box mindset to translating client challenges into clear, achievable solutions 
 
• Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational hands-on delivery to ensure solutions actually work for clients 
 
• Ability to combine creative thinking with practical execution 
 
• Analytical, process driven and critical mindset with a continuous improvement focus 
 
• Comfortable working with figures and data 
 
• Strong organizational, administrative and time management skills to handle various deadlines simultaneously 
 
• Proficient written and verbal communication skills in Dutch, French and English (any additional language is a plus) 
 
• Comfortable using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, Teams) 
 
• Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, external partners and technical teams alike 
 
• Eager to learn and pro-actively take ownership 
 
• Professional Bachelor or university degree preferred

You will be responsible for the assembly and mounting of products.
You will be trained as a multi-skilled worker and deployed across 8 different workstations.

You are able to work in a two-shift system and can work both independently and as part of a team.
You already have some initial experience in assembly work.
You are punctual and work accurately.
You speak English or Dutch so that you can communicate with colleagues.

• 
You will ensure correct processing and shipping of incoming goods.

 
• 
Here you follow a pick order to pack and sort the goods according to destination.

 
• 
You can remain calm in stressful situations

 
• 
You can maintain a good overview of your work

 
• 
You can communicate perfectly in English.

 
• 
You will work from 08:00 to 16:15.

Robert Half is looking for a Customer Service Representative (Italian/French/English) (M/F/X) in Zaventem.

Do you have excellent knowledge of Italian, French and English? Are you looking for a permanent position within a dynamic and international team? We are seeking a customer-oriented, detail-focused team player for a growing company in the diplomatic sector.

Your responsibilities:

• Customer contact by phone and email;
• Maintain and update customer files (including specific customs documents);
• Perform daily checks, checklists, and follow up on overdue files;
• Work with proprietary software; fast and comfortable using PC;
• Collaborate with internal colleagues and external partners.

Profile:

• Excellent Italian, French and English required; -
• You must have a bachelor or masters degree.
• You live in Belgium and are eligible to work here.
• You can reach the company easily (Zaventem)
• Accurate and detail-oriented, affinity with administrative processes
• Team player, able to work independently; flexibility is a must
You must meet all requirements to be considered for this position.

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

Are you looking to kickstart your career in construction? Join us as a General Construction Worker where every day is a new opportunity to make a tangible impact. You'll be working on varied projects, gaining hands-on experience in demolition, masonry, insulation, and more. 

Your typical day will be dynamic and rewarding. You'll assist skilled workers, ensure site safety, and help maintain project flow. Your contribution is critical in creating structures that stand strong and look impressive. 

Ready to put your skills to the test and grow with us? Apply today and be part of a team that values your effort and dedication.

• Experience in construction (minimum one year)

• Communicative English skills

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow in construction

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation (a plus)

• VCA certificate

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

On an average day, you'll troubleshoot machine malfunctions, perform preventive maintenance, and collaborate with machine setters and operators to enhance production processes. Your proactive efforts will contribute to improvements in quality, output, and safety.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

• Technical school degree

• Good level of English

• Flexibility, motivation, and a strong sense of responsibility

• Experience in pneumatics and hydraulics is a plus

• Problem-solving mindset

• Willingness to work shifts

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and French

Our client is a large Belgian organization that plays a key role within an extensive and technically complex infrastructure environment. Behind the scenes, business-critical IT systems ensure that operational processes can run safely, reliably and efficiently.
As part of a broad IT digitalization program, significant investments will be made over the coming years in renewing and optimizing processes, applications and digital services. To support this transformation, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can immerse themselves in the business and help determine where and how digitalization can genuinely create value.
This is a long-term project within a stable enterprise environment, with contracts that can be renewed annually.

jobs.occupation: Sales operations representative EN/DE | Brecht | Permanent Contract
jobs.description:
Position: Sales Operations Representative / Order Administrator 

Location: Brecht 

As a Sales Operations Representative / Order Processor, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth order processing and customer satisfaction. You will follow up on orders, report and resolve incidents, and communicate effectively with both customers and internal departments. You will coordinate shipments with factories and be an integral part of the team based in Brecht, handling orders for the US market. 

Primary Duties & Responsibilities: 

 
• Review incoming customer orders for items, pricing, and export license requirements. 
 
• Process sales orders in the ERP system (SAP) using the ESKER tool. 
 
• Process purchase orders at manufacturing plants, if required. 
 
• Follow up on sales orders with manufacturing plants and warehouses to ensure timely delivery. 
 
• Communicate with customers regarding their orders; resolve delivery issues, respond to inquiries, and provide necessary delivery documentation. 
 
• Request export documentation from customers as needed. 
 
• Invoice customers after delivery and monitor customer balances prior to shipment. 
 
• Maintain and closely monitor order backlog. 
 
• Record orders and customer information in internal systems and files. 
 
• Serve as a backup for other Sales Operations Specialists when needed. 

 
• A college Diploma or equivalent required, AS or higher in business preferred. 
 
• A first experience in Customer service - Order Processing is required. 
 
• A very good and professional command of English is required. In addition, a good command of German is required. 
 
• Ability to communicate effectively: strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 
• Flexible, easy-going and able to adapt to a fast-paced and sometimes changing environment. 
 
• Good time management skills with the ability to prioritize, follow-through, and complete tasks on time. 
 
• Focused and versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure. 
 
• Detail oriented with high level of accuracy. 
 
• Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills. 
 
• Self-motivated and good level of focus/concentration. 
 
• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. 
 
• Strong computer skills and experience with SAP. 
 
• You have your own transportation and a valid driving license (difficult to reach by public transport).
